## History

Gertie Pye was among the schoolmates who warmly welcomed [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ended her self-imposed absence. Along with the other local girls, Gertie wore fashionable dresses with puffed sleeves, which stood out to [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and prompted him to acquire a similar stylish dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXV.
